blocks.x: The stack is boring by design — proven components, no experimental dependencies:

items: S/4Hana As The Operational Truth
Orders, stock and finance stay authoritative in S/4; analytics read from it, never around it.
Sap Datasphere
The governed SAP data layer — business semantics preserved instead of flattened away.
Btp
SAP's extension platform used for what it is good at — side-by-side extension without destabilizing the core.
Event Mesh
Events routed by brokered topology — consumers subscribe to meaning, not to endpoints.
Master-Data Governance Before Any Ai Is Applied
The customer, product and asset records get one definition each before a model ever sees them.
freshness SLOs
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
dbt transformation graph
Tested, documented models with lineage exposure — the transform layer your analysts can actually read.
Delta / Iceberg tables
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
data contracts
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.

blocks.x: Joint delivery on SAP Alliance is designed for handover from the first week — runbooks written as we go, decisions mapped to your owners, nothing that only we can operate.
Artifacts, not anecdotes — at the first-quarter close your team holds:

items: Joint architecture pack
The target architecture drawn against your estate, with interfaces and owners made explicit.
Certified delivery pod
A named team with the clearances your estate requires — the same people from diagnosis to handover.
Support map
Who answers when something breaks — named roles, response expectations and the escalation path.

blocks.x: Ask for the SAP reference pack — or bring your use case to a joint working session with both platform teams.
